decisive_items: Spindle cells and cords of epithelioid cells around numerous blood vessels
Positive for vimentin, desmin, smooth muscle actin, and estrogen and progesterone receptors
response.rationale: Benign smooth-muscle phenotype with fibroid history and hormone-receptor positivity favors uterine leiomyoma; sarcoma is excluded by absent atypia/mitoses and adenomyosis by the pathology, while cellular leiomyoma is less supported by the loose fibromyxoid stroma.

rejected.why: Malignant diagnosis contradicted by benign frozen section, lack of mitotic atypia, and well-demarcated border.
Adenomyosis would show endometrial glands and stroma within myometrium, not an adnexal smooth-muscle tumor with these immunohistochemical findings.
